{{Short description|Argentine-American mathematician}}
'''Maria Elena Schonbek''' is an Argentine-American mathematician at the [[University of California, Santa Cruz]]. Her research concerns [[fluid dynamics]] and associated [[partial differential equation]]s such as the [[Navier–Stokes equations]].<ref name="ucsc">[http://schonbek.math.ucsc.edu/ Maria Schonbek] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181102014646/https://schonbek.math.ucsc.edu/ |date=2018-11-02 }}, Department of Mathematics, University of California, Santa Cruz</ref><ref name=awarding/>

==Education and career==
Schonbek received a [[bachelor's degree]] from the [[University of Buenos Aires]].<ref name="ucsc"/> She completed her Ph.D. at the [[University of Michigan]] in 1976. Her dissertation, ''Boundary Value Problems for the Fitzhugh–Nagumo Equations'', was supervised by [[Jeffrey Rauch]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=5268|title=Maria Schonbek}}</ref>

Schonbek joined the University of California, Santa Cruz faculty in 1986.<ref name=awarding/>
Formerly a professor of mathematics there,<ref name="ucsc"/> she has retired to become a [[professor emeritus]].<ref>[https://www.math.ucsc.edu/faculty-research/emeriti.php?uid=schonbek Maria Schonbek], Emeriti, UC Santa Cruz Mathematics</ref>
At Santa Cruz, Schonbek advocated replacing the campus's system of narrative evaluations of student performance in each course with the more standard system of [[letter grade]]s used at most other US universities.<ref>{{citation|newspaper=[[Los Angeles Times]]|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2000-nov-28-mn-58211-story.html|title=UC Santa Cruz to Retain Distinctive Written Appraisals|date=November 28, 2000|first=Kenneth R.|last=Weiss}}</ref>

==Recognition==
In 2012, Schonbek became a member of the inaugural class of fellows of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society |access-date=2014-12-22 |archive-date=2018-08-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name=awarding>{{citation|newspaper=City on a Hill Press|title=Awarding Mathematical Excellence|date=November 15, 2012|url=http://www.cityonahillpress.com/2012/11/15/awarding-mathematical-excellence/}}</ref>
